confidence_notes: Restaurant, coffee and beer estimates use [Numbeo's user-submitted local prices](https://it.numbeo.com/costo-della-vita/citt%C3%A0/La-Spezia), which have limited contributor coverage. Cocktail and wine are less certain and are inferred as a premium over, and roughly equal to, beer respectively. Accommodation prices are holistic July estimates; hostel beds and private rooms are especially uncertain.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on a mid-sized Ligurian coastal city with strong summer demand as a gateway to the Cinque Terre, while generally being less expensive than the villages themselves.
